title: Lue, kuuntele, kirjoita, puhu
description: The seven instruction words of every YKI task. Read a real task instruction in five minutes.

steps.title: Your first YKI words
steps.content_html: Every YKI task starts with an instruction in Finnish. Learn seven words today and you can read a real task.

steps.title: Four parts, four words
steps.content_html: YKI has four parts, and each one has its word: <fi>Lue</fi> (read), <fi>Kuuntele</fi> (listen), <fi>Kirjoita</fi> (write), <fi>Puhu</fi> (speak). They are commands: the test speaks to you directly.

steps.title: Four parts
steps.instruction: Match each word with its meaning.

steps.title: Answer, choose, tell
steps.content_html: Three more words tell you what to do: <fi>Vastaa</fi> (answer), <fi>Valitse</fi> (choose), <fi>Kerro</fi> (tell). You will see them in full instructions: <fi>Vastaa kysymyksiin.</fi> Answer the questions. <fi>Valitse oikea vaihtoehto.</fi> Choose the right option.
steps.tts_text: Vastaa kysymyksiin. Valitse oikea vaihtoehto. Kerro itsestäsi.

steps.title: What do you do?
steps.question: The task says: Valitse oikea vaihtoehto. What do you do?
steps.correct_feedback: Right: valitse = choose, oikea vaihtoehto = the right option.
steps.incorrect_feedback: Valitse means choose. Oikea vaihtoehto is the right option.

steps.title: Complete the instruction
steps.translation_hint: Read the text and answer the questions.
steps.correct_feedback: Yes. Lue teksti: read the text.
steps.incorrect_feedback: A text is read: Lue teksti.

steps.title: A writing task
steps.scenario: The instruction says: Kirjoita viesti ystävälle.

options.text: Write a message to a friend
Read a message from a friend

steps.correct_feedback: Right: kirjoita = write, viesti = message, ystävälle = to a friend.
steps.incorrect_feedback: Kirjoita means write. The task is to write a message.

steps.title: Listen to the instruction
steps.question: What does the test ask you to do?
steps.correct_feedback: Yes. Kerro itsestäsi: tell about yourself. It is the first speaking task.
steps.incorrect_feedback: Kerro means tell. Itsestäsi means about yourself.

steps.title: You can read YKI instructions
steps.content_html: Lue, kuuntele, kirjoita, puhu, vastaa, valitse, kerro. Seven words, and every YKI task now tells you what to do.
